    {n : ℕ} {C : CollaborationStrategy n} {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hp : Interior p)
    {k : Fin n} (hhalf_ne : p k ≠ (1 : ℝ) / 2)
    (hbad : C p ≠ roundProb (p k)) :
    ∃ S : JointLawCollaborationSetting n,
      source_assumption_strategy_expectation_well_formed S C ∧
        S.strategyAccuracy C < S.agentAccuracy k ∧

    simpa [T, FiniteCollaborationSetting.toAccuracySurface,

      JointLawCollaborationSetting.ofFinite_agentAccuracy] using hweak.1
  · intro i
    have hweak := part1Setting_weakCounterexample (C := C) hp hhalf_ne hbad
    simpa [T, FiniteCollaborationSetting.toAccuracySurface,
      JointLawCollaborationSetting.ofFinite_strategyAccuracy,

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: The raw joint-law mixture scales every measurable embedded input-label event by its component weight, preserves predictors on that component, preserves each agent accuracy, and preserves strategy accuracy when the source expectation is well formed.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This is an event-level full-joint-law statement; it deliberately does not assert a nonexistent pointwise conditional-label equality on arbitrary null fibers.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Form the disjoint-union mixture of collaboration settings and obtain the two displayed componentwise accuracy equations.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: For each of the three source finite witnesses, Lean defines the exact cell map, constructs its predictor from the raw finite input-label PMF, and proves pointwise equality with the witness predictor used in the calibration and strict-gap arguments.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes construction provenance for every finite partition actually used by the proof. It does not extend the separate generic partition paragraph beyond finite measurable cell maps.
checked_proof_steps.source_locator: cited publication:198-247; cited publication:283-292; cited publication:314-340
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Use the displayed agent-dependent finite partitions in Lemma 8 and in both Proposition 9 settings to obtain the advertised predictors as conditional label-one probabilities of their cells.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: From the negation of fixed off-half deferral, the checked construction chooses one interior bad tuple per agent, forms the literal uniform finite mixture, and embeds it as a raw joint-law setting on which strategy accuracy is strictly below every agent accuracy.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes the strict uniform-mixture inequality itself, rather than relying only on a later reliability conclusion.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Average one Lemma 8 setting per agent with weight 1/n and infer that every agent strictly beats the strategy.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: The checked construction uses the concrete weights 7/8 for S1 and 1/8 for S2, proves both componentwise accuracy equations, and proves the resulting raw joint-law setting has strategy accuracy strictly below every agent accuracy.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes the source's existential close-enough argument with one explicit rational witness.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Take lambda sufficiently close to one when mixing S1 and S2 so that every agent strictly beats the strategy.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean defines both pointwise quantities and proves expected correctness equals one minus expected 0-1 loss for each binary prediction and conditional label probability.
defects.repair_obligation: Distinguish pointwise expected correctness from 0-1 loss and prove that the two quantities sum to one.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked source-facing correction proves the complement identity by cases on the binary prediction; the model and all witness accuracies use expected correctness.
defects.source_claim: The source labels E[|Yhat(X)-Y|] as 0-1 accuracy, although this expectation is 0-1 loss; the later agent formula and proof use expected correctness.
defects.status_impact_rationale: This is a local terminology/complement typo. Replacing the opening quantity by one minus the displayed loss agrees with the subsequent individual-accuracy formula and leaves every advertised result unchanged.

defects.acceptance_condition: The report identifies event calibration as the accepted source reading, and Lean proves calibration and accuracy from that exact model.
defects.repair_obligation: Record the accepted event-calibration reading visibly rather than silently choosing a pointwise conditional version.
defects.resolution_evidence: The current raw model makes the event identity explicit and proves the agent-accuracy formula. The report records the user-approved interpretation rather than claiming a selected conditional version on every null fiber.
defects.source_claim: Calibration is written as a point-conditioned equality for every p in Image(P), without defining a conditional probability on a zero-probability prediction fiber.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The source wording is under-specified on null prediction fibers, but the user approved the event-calibration reading as the formal source model. Lean proves calibration and the advertised accuracy formula in that explicit model.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean checks equal point accuracies for the paper's correct and incorrect labels at eta=1/2, and separately derives a strict gap from correctness, incorrectness, and eta not equal to 1/2.
defects.repair_obligation: Exhibit the half-tie counterexample and prove strict accuracy dominance after adding eta not equal to one half.

defects.repair_obligation: Record the accepted finite measurable partition and zero-cell convention visibly.

defects.source_claim: The source says that an arbitrary partition induces a calibrated predictor by assigning every cell its conditional label-one probability, without measurability, null-cell, or finiteness conditions.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The source does not spell out measurability or a null-cell value, but the user approved the finite measurable, zero-cell totalization used by every source witness as the formal source reading.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean proves the forward theorem under the explicit raw joint-law event-calibration convention and constructs a finite calibrated one-agent setting on which an interior-non-collaborative boundary-flipping strategy has agent accuracy one and strategy accuracy zero.
defects.repair_obligation: Keep the source's forward reliability-to-non-collaboration theorem and refute the converse using a non-collaborative strategy whose boundary behavior fails reliability on a calibrated setting.

defects.source_claim: The proof section restates Theorem 1 as an if-and-only-if between reliability and the interior fixed-agent/fixed-tie condition, although Definition 4 constrains no boundary profile.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean formalizes the entire S1 family for 0 < epsilon < 1/2, proves the displayed masses, predictors, calibration, and strict gap for every other agent.
defects.repair_obligation: State the positive lower bound needed for the conditional probabilities and for the claimed interior profiles.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked parameterized S1 construction uses exactly 0 < epsilon < 1/2; its epsilon=1/4 instance is retained only as a regression specialization.
defects.source_claim: The first Proposition 9 setting says only epsilon < 1/2 while using epsilon and 1-epsilon as conditional probabilities and asserting that both induced profiles lie in (0,1)^n.

model_conventions.checked_scope: The current source-facing model proves the individual-accuracy formula from this event identity and embeds each finite adversarial witness as an exact joint PMF with unchanged classifier accuracies.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: A collaboration setting is represented by one probability law on X x {0,1}, rather than by an input marginal plus a selected pointwise conditional-label function. Predictors are measurable [0,1]-valued functions and calibration means, for every measurable A, E[1_{P_i(X) in A,Y=1}] = E[P_i(X) 1_{P_i(X) in A}].
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: User-approved formalization convention: the paper's calibration display is read through this event-calibration semantics. The report records that this does not select a pointwise conditional version on every arbitrary input space.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source writes conditioning on P_i(X)=p for every reported p, but a raw joint law does not canonically specify conditional probabilities on zero-probability prediction fibers. The event identity is meaningful for both atomic and atomless prediction laws.

model_conventions.checked_scope: The raw reliability predicate carries the strategy-expectation well-formedness premise; the source proof's finite witnesses discharge it directly.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: Predictors are measurable, and a strategy is used in an accuracy comparison only when its induced binary-correctness indicator is integrable under the joint law. On finite witnesses this condition is automatic.
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: This is an analytic well-formedness convention, not a claim that every set-theoretic deterministic function [0,1]^n -> {0,1} is measurable on every possible input space.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source uses P_i(X), calibration events, and expected strategy accuracy while allowing an arbitrary deterministic C. Those expressions need measurability and integrability on an arbitrary measurable input space.

model_conventions.checked_scope: Every partition used by the source's Lemma 8 and Proposition 9 witnesses is finite and is covered by the raw joint-law construction, including agent-dependent finite cell types.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: The checked partition construction takes a finite measurable cell map for each agent. A positive-mass cell receives true-label mass divided by total cell mass; a null cell is assigned zero.
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: User-approved formalization convention: the source partition sentence is read as the finite measurable cell construction used by its proof, with zero on a null cell. The report retains this scope choice without treating arbitrary atomless partitions as an open proof obligation.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source says only 'partition'. Measurability is needed to form the events, and finiteness is needed for the checked zero-cell totalization to remain expectation-irrelevant and for the calibrated event identity to follow by a finite sum.

    JointLawCollaborationSetting.agentAccuracy_mix S w hw_nonneg hw_sum, ?_⟩
  intro C hC
  exact ⟨JointLawCollaborationSetting.strategyWellFormed_mix
      S w hw_nonneg hw_sum C hC,

PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_formula_lemma8_masses {n : ℕ} (b : Label) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
  part1Odds false (p i) = (1 - p i) / p i ∧
    part1Odds true (p i) = p i / (1 - p i) ∧
      part1Mass b p none = 1 / part1Denom b p ∧
        part1Mass b p (some i) = part1Odds b (p i) / part1Denom b p ∧ part1Denom b p = 1 + ∑ j, part1Odds b (p j)
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_formula_lemma8_labels_and_predictions {n : ℕ} (b : Label) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
  part1Eta b none = labelReal !b ∧
    part1Eta b (some j) = labelReal b ∧
      part1Pred b p i none = p i ∧ part1Pred b p i (some j) = if j = i then p i else labelReal b
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_lemma8_partition_realization {n : ℕ} (b : Label) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : Interior p) (i : Fin n)
  (x : Part1Point n) :
  (finiteJointLawPartitionCollaborationSetting (finiteJointLawPMF (part1Setting b p hp)) fun j =>
          part1SourceCell j).pred
      i x =
    part1Pred b p i x
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_lemma8_witness_calibrated {n : ℕ} (b : Label) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : Interior p) (i : Fin n)
  (r : ℝ) :
  (eventLabelMass (part1Mass b p) (part1Eta b) fun x => part1Pred b p i x = r) =
    r * eventMass (part1Mass b p) fun x => part1Pred b p i x = r
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_formula_proposition9_s1_family {n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2) (k : Fin n) :
  part2S1ParamMass false = 1 / 3 ∧
    part2S1ParamMass true = 2 / 3 ∧
      part2S1ParamEta ε false = ε ∧
        part2S1ParamEta ε true = 1 - ε ∧
          part2S1ParamKPred ε = 2 / 3 - ε / 3 ∧
            (∀ (i : Fin n) (x : Part2S1ParamPoint),
                part2S1ParamPred ε k i x = if i = k then part2S1ParamKPred ε else part2S1ParamEta ε x) ∧
              ∀ (i : Fin n) (r : ℝ),
                (eventMass part2S1ParamMass fun x => part2S1ParamPred ε k i x = r) > 0 →
                  (eventLabelMass part2S1ParamMass (part2S1ParamEta ε) fun x => part2S1ParamPred ε k i x = r) =
                    r * eventMass part2S1ParamMass fun x => part2S1ParamPred ε k i x = r
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_s1_positive_parameter_validity {n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
  (k : Fin n) :
  (∀ (x : Part2S1ParamPoint), 0 ≤ part2S1ParamEta ε x ∧ part2S1ParamEta ε x ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin n) (x : Part2S1ParamPoint), 0 ≤ part2S1ParamPred ε k i x ∧ part2S1ParamPred ε k i x ≤ 1) ∧
      ∀ (x : Part2S1ParamPoint), Interior fun i => part2S1ParamPred ε k i x
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_s1_partition_realization {n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
  (k i : Fin n) (x : Part2S1ParamPoint) :
  (finiteJointLawPartitionCollaborationSetting (finiteJointLawPMF (part2S1ParamSetting ε hε0 hεhalf k)) fun j =>
          part2S1ParamSourceCell k j).pred
      i x =
    part2S1ParamPred ε k i x
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_s1_parameterized_accuracy_gap {n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2)
  {C : CollaborationStrategy n} {k : Fin n} (hk : DefersAwayFromHalf C k) :
  FiniteCollaborationSetting.strategyAccuracy C (part2S1ParamSetting ε hε0 hεhalf k) = 2 / 3 - ε / 3 ∧
    (part2S1ParamSetting ε hε0 hεhalf k).agentAccuracy k = 2 / 3 - ε / 3 ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin n),
        i ≠ k →
          (part2S1ParamSetting ε hε0 hεhalf k).agentAccuracy i = 1 - ε ∧
            FiniteCollaborationSetting.strategyAccuracy C (part2S1ParamSetting ε hε0 hεhalf k) <
              (part2S1ParamSetting ε hε0 hεhalf k).agentAccuracy i
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_formula_proposition9_s2_repaired_normalizer {n : ℕ} (p q : Fin n → ℝ) :
  part2S2Denom p q = 2 + ∑ j, (p j / (1 - p j) + (1 - q j) / q j)
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_s2_repaired_mass_normalized {n : ℕ} {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hp : Interior p)
  (hq : Interior q) : ∑ x, part2S2Mass p q x = 1
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_formula_proposition9_s2_construction {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) (p q : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
  (x : Part1Point n) :
  part2S2WeightP p q = part1Denom true p / (part1Denom true p + part1Denom false q) ∧
    part2S2WeightQ p q = part1Denom false q / (part1Denom true p + part1Denom false q) ∧
      part2S2Mass p q (false, x) = part2S2WeightP p q * part1Mass true p x ∧
        part2S2Mass p q (true, x) = part2S2WeightQ p q * part1Mass false q x ∧
          part2S2Eta (false, x) = part1Eta true x ∧
            part2S2Eta (true, x) = part1Eta false x ∧
              (part2S2Pred k p q i (false, x) =
                  if i = k then
                    match x with
                    | none => 1 / 2
                    | some val => part1Eta true x
                  else part1Pred true p i x) ∧
                part2S2Pred k p q i (true, x) =
                  if i = k then
                    match x with
                    | none => 1 / 2
                    | some val => part1Eta false x
                  else part1Pred false q i x
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_s2_partition_realization {n : ℕ} {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hp : Interior p)
  (hq : Interior q) (k i : Fin n) (x : Part2S2Point n) :
  (finiteJointLawPartitionCollaborationSetting (finiteJointLawPMF (part2S2Setting k p q hp hq)) fun j =>
          part2S2SourceCell k j).pred
      i x =
    part2S2Pred k p q i x
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_s2_calibrated {n : ℕ} {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hp : Interior p) (hq : Interior q)
  (k i : Fin n) (r : ℝ) :
  (eventLabelMass (part2S2Mass p q) part2S2Eta fun x => part2S2Pred k p q i x = r) =
    r * eventMass (part2S2Mass p q) fun x => part2S2Pred k p q i x = r
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_s2_strict_gap {n : ℕ} {C : CollaborationStrategy n} {k : Fin n} {p q : Fin n → ℝ}
  (hp : Interior p) (hq : Interior q) (hpk : p k = 1 / 2) (hqk : q k = 1 / 2) (hCp : C p = true) (hCq : C q = false) :
  (fun i => part2S2Pred k p q i (false, none)) = p ∧
    (fun i => part2S2Pred k p q i (true, none)) = q ∧
      FiniteCollaborationSetting.strategyAccuracy C (part2S2Setting k p q hp hq) <
        (part2S2Setting k p q hp hq).agentAccuracy k
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_reliability_forces_fixed_tie_label {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
  (C : CollaborationStrategy n) (k : Fin n) (hrel : ReliableJointLaw C) (hk : DefersAwayFromHalf C k) :
  ∃ alpha, ConstantOnHalfSlice C k alpha
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_formula_proposition9_explicit_final_mixture {n : ℕ} (S1 S2 : FiniteCollaborationSetting n) :
  ∃ Smix,
    (∀ (i : Fin n), Smix.agentAccuracy i = 7 / 8 * S1.agentAccuracy i + 1 / 8 * S2.agentAccuracy i) ∧
      ∀ (C : CollaborationStrategy n),
        source_assumption_strategy_expectation_well_formed Smix C ∧
          Smix.strategyAccuracy C =
            7 / 8 * FiniteCollaborationSetting.strategyAccuracy C S1 +
              1 / 8 * FiniteCollaborationSetting.strategyAccuracy C S2
PKG25NoFreeLunch.source_proposition9_explicit_final_mixture_strict_counterexample {n : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin n)]
  {C : CollaborationStrategy n} {k : Fin n} {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hk : DefersAwayFromHalf C k) (hp : Interior p)
  (hq : Interior q) (hpk : p k = 1 / 2) (hqk : q k = 1 / 2) (hCp : C p = true) (hCq : C q = false) :

    source_assumption_strategy_expectation_well_formed Smix C ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin n), Smix.strategyAccuracy C < Smix.agentAccuracy i

theorem source_proposition6_linear_combination_settings
    {n ell : ℕ} (S : Fin ell → JointLawCollaborationSetting n)
    (w : Fin ell → ℝ)
    (hw_nonneg : ∀ r : Fin ell, 0 ≤ w r)
    (hw_sum : ∑ r : Fin ell, w r = 1) :
    ∃ Smix : JointLawCollaborationSetting n,
      (∀ i : Fin n,
        Smix.agentAccuracy i = ∑ r : Fin ell, w r * (S r).agentAccuracy i) ∧
      (∀ C : CollaborationStrategy n,
        (∀ r : Fin ell,
          source_assumption_strategy_expectation_well_formed (S r) C) →
        source_assumption_strategy_expectation_well_formed Smix C ∧
          Smix.strategyAccuracy C =

    JointLawCollaborationSetting.agentAccuracy_mix S w hw_nonneg hw_sum, ?_⟩

dimensions.required_check: Compare the Lean carrier, finiteness/order/subtype restrictions, and every generic Type/Sort quantifier with the source domain. An arbitrary carrier or a silently strengthened finite carrier needs a source anchor or a checked bridge. When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. Strict adjacent-tail comparisons do not by themselves supply a terminal cutoff or positive top/bottom atom; inspect zero mass, degenerate, and boundary cases separately.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type surface
dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. theorem source_lemma8_bad_tuple_counterexample_setting
    {n : ℕ} {C : CollaborationStrategy n} {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hp : Interior p)
    {k : Fin n} (hhalf_ne : p k ≠ (1 : ℝ) / 2)
    (hbad : C p ≠ roundProb (p k)) :
    ∃ S : JointLawCollaborationSetting n,
      source_assumption_strategy_expectation_well_formed S C ∧
        S.strategyAccuracy C < S.agentAccuracy k ∧
          ∀ i : Fin n, S.strategyAccuracy C ≤ S.agentAccuracy i := by
  let T : FiniteCollaborationSetting n := part1Setting (C p) p hp
  refine ⟨JointLawCollaborationSetting.ofFinite T,
    JointLawCollaborationSetting.ofFinite_strategyWellFormed C T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hweak := part1Setting_weakCounterexample (C := C) hp hhalf_ne hbad
    simpa [T, FiniteCollaborationSetting.toAccuracySurface,
      JointLawCollaborationSetting.ofFinite_strategyAccuracy,
      JointLawCollaborationSetting.ofFinite_agentAccuracy] using hweak.1
  · intro i
    have hweak := part1Setting_weakCounterexample (C := C) hp hhalf_ne hbad
    simpa [T, FiniteCollaborationSetting.toAccuracySurface,
      JointLawCollaborationSetting.ofFinite_strategyAccuracy,
      JointLawCollaborationSetting.ofFinite_agentAccuracy] using hweak.2 i

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: The raw joint-law mixture scales every measurable embedded input-label event by its component weight, preserves predictors on that component, preserves each agent accuracy, and preserves strategy accuracy when the source expectation is well formed.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This is an event-level full-joint-law statement; it deliberately does not assert a nonexistent pointwise conditional-label equality on arbitrary null fibers.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Form the disjoint-union mixture of collaboration settings and obtain the two displayed componentwise accuracy equations.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: For each of the three source finite witnesses, Lean defines the exact cell map, constructs its predictor from the raw finite input-label PMF, and proves pointwise equality with the witness predictor used in the calibration and strict-gap arguments.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes construction provenance for every finite partition actually used by the proof. It does not extend the separate generic partition paragraph beyond finite measurable cell maps.
checked_proof_steps.source_locator: cited publication:198-247; cited publication:283-292; cited publication:314-340
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Use the displayed agent-dependent finite partitions in Lemma 8 and in both Proposition 9 settings to obtain the advertised predictors as conditional label-one probabilities of their cells.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: From the negation of fixed off-half deferral, the checked construction chooses one interior bad tuple per agent, forms the literal uniform finite mixture, and embeds it as a raw joint-law setting on which strategy accuracy is strictly below every agent accuracy.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes the strict uniform-mixture inequality itself, rather than relying only on a later reliability conclusion.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Average one Lemma 8 setting per agent with weight 1/n and infer that every agent strictly beats the strategy.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: The checked construction uses the concrete weights 7/8 for S1 and 1/8 for S2, proves both componentwise accuracy equations, and proves the resulting raw joint-law setting has strategy accuracy strictly below every agent accuracy.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes the source's existential close-enough argument with one explicit rational witness.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Take lambda sufficiently close to one when mixing S1 and S2 so that every agent strictly beats the strategy.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean defines both pointwise quantities and proves expected correctness equals one minus expected 0-1 loss for each binary prediction and conditional label probability.
defects.repair_obligation: Distinguish pointwise expected correctness from 0-1 loss and prove that the two quantities sum to one.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked source-facing correction proves the complement identity by cases on the binary prediction; the model and all witness accuracies use expected correctness.
defects.source_claim: The source labels E[|Yhat(X)-Y|] as 0-1 accuracy, although this expectation is 0-1 loss; the later agent formula and proof use expected correctness.
defects.status_impact_rationale: This is a local terminology/complement typo. Replacing the opening quantity by one minus the displayed loss agrees with the subsequent individual-accuracy formula and leaves every advertised result unchanged.

defects.acceptance_condition: The report identifies event calibration as the accepted source reading, and Lean proves calibration and accuracy from that exact model.
defects.repair_obligation: Record the accepted event-calibration reading visibly rather than silently choosing a pointwise conditional version.
defects.resolution_evidence: The current raw model makes the event identity explicit and proves the agent-accuracy formula. The report records the user-approved interpretation rather than claiming a selected conditional version on every null fiber.
defects.source_claim: Calibration is written as a point-conditioned equality for every p in Image(P), without defining a conditional probability on a zero-probability prediction fiber.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The source wording is under-specified on null prediction fibers, but the user approved the event-calibration reading as the formal source model. Lean proves calibration and the advertised accuracy formula in that explicit model.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean checks equal point accuracies for the paper's correct and incorrect labels at eta=1/2, and separately derives a strict gap from correctness, incorrectness, and eta not equal to 1/2.
defects.repair_obligation: Exhibit the half-tie counterexample and prove strict accuracy dominance after adding eta not equal to one half.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked interface contains both the half-tie counterexample and the repaired strict-gap statement; the Lemma 8 witness proves its strict comparisons directly rather than using the defective unrestricted sentence.
defects.source_claim: The proof preliminaries claim that one positive-mass point where classifier i is correct and classifier j is incorrect always makes i strictly more accurate than j.
defects.status_impact_rationale: At conditional label probability one half, the tie convention names one label correct and the other incorrect although both have accuracy one half. Adding the omitted non-tie condition repairs the observation, and later witness cells that use strict correctness have conditional label probability zero or one.

defects.acceptance_condition: The checked mixture uses one nonnegative weight per component, proves that the weights sum to one, and derives both displayed accuracy equations with the same component index.
defects.repair_obligation: Use the component-indexed weight lambda_m consistently in the sampling sentence and normalization argument.

model_conventions.checked_scope: The current source-facing model proves the individual-accuracy formula from this event identity and embeds each finite adversarial witness as an exact joint PMF with unchanged classifier accuracies.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: A collaboration setting is represented by one probability law on X x {0,1}, rather than by an input marginal plus a selected pointwise conditional-label function. Predictors are measurable [0,1]-valued functions and calibration means, for every measurable A, E[1_{P_i(X) in A,Y=1}] = E[P_i(X) 1_{P_i(X) in A}].
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: User-approved formalization convention: the paper's calibration display is read through this event-calibration semantics. The report records that this does not select a pointwise conditional version on every arbitrary input space.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source writes conditioning on P_i(X)=p for every reported p, but a raw joint law does not canonically specify conditional probabilities on zero-probability prediction fibers. The event identity is meaningful for both atomic and atomless prediction laws.

model_conventions.checked_scope: The raw reliability predicate carries the strategy-expectation well-formedness premise; the source proof's finite witnesses discharge it directly.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: Predictors are measurable, and a strategy is used in an accuracy comparison only when its induced binary-correctness indicator is integrable under the joint law. On finite witnesses this condition is automatic.
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: This is an analytic well-formedness convention, not a claim that every set-theoretic deterministic function [0,1]^n -> {0,1} is measurable on every possible input space.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source uses P_i(X), calibration events, and expected strategy accuracy while allowing an arbitrary deterministic C. Those expressions need measurability and integrability on an arbitrary measurable input space.

model_conventions.checked_scope: Every partition used by the source's Lemma 8 and Proposition 9 witnesses is finite and is covered by the raw joint-law construction, including agent-dependent finite cell types.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: The checked partition construction takes a finite measurable cell map for each agent. A positive-mass cell receives true-label mass divided by total cell mass; a null cell is assigned zero.
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: User-approved formalization convention: the source partition sentence is read as the finite measurable cell construction used by its proof, with zero on a null cell. The report retains this scope choice without treating arbitrary atomless partitions as an open proof obligation.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source says only 'partition'. Measurability is needed to form the events, and finiteness is needed for the checked zero-cell totalization to remain expectation-irrelevant and for the calibrated event identity to follow by a finite sum.

dimensions.required_check: Compare the Lean carrier, finiteness/order/subtype restrictions, and every generic Type/Sort quantifier with the source domain. An arbitrary carrier or a silently strengthened finite carrier needs a source anchor or a checked bridge. When an expanded finite carrier encodes a source cardinal parameter through index arithmetic such as Fin (n + c), state the source parameter, the Lean expression, and a proved translation; local type names and inferred cardinality are not evidence. When a strict conclusion needs distinct, non-endpoint, or interior carrier elements, derive the exact cardinality threshold and witness from the source; a bare source phrase such as 'n candidates' does not supply N >= 3. When the generated surface requests a cardinality-boundary analysis, record the source and Lean cardinal domains, every smallest/endpoint case checked, and either the strictness witness or a semantic reason no such witness is needed. A theorem, wrapper, or carrier name is not that analysis. A local opaque/constant/axiom carrier must expose a checked refinement before it is treated as ordinary model data.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type with finite or ordered carrier
dimensions.required_check: For a finite/ordered probabilistic model, derive support at each endpoint from the source condition actually stated. Strict adjacent-tail comparisons do not by themselves supply a terminal cutoff or positive top/bottom atom; inspect zero mass, degenerate, and boundary cases separately.

expanded_shape_basis: expanded probability-law type surface
unexpanded or bounded terminal definition path requiring a semantic bridge
dimensions.required_check: Identify the source stochastic process and the Lean joint law separately. Do not replace a source state recurrence, conditioning rule, or time-indexed law with an iid/product construction without a Lean-checked equality, simulation, or refinement from the source primitives. If either side sorts, ranks, relabels, or quotients samples before computing an outcome, prove the corresponding pushforward and outcome-equivariance bridge; matching marginal tables or an informal exchangeability argument is not enough. When the generated surface requests transformed-law analysis, record the source and Lean operations, the full parameter domain including sign/zero endpoints, normalization or pushforward evidence, and outcome-equivariance evidence (or an explicit semantic no-transform/no-relabeling finding). Separately write the source and Lean distribution parameterizations: the exact scale/rate/precision/standard-deviation/variance convention, the parameter mapping formula, and a checked law equality or outcome-preservation bridge. A positive reparameterization or matching declaration name is not a law-equivalence argument. When a standard Measure/Kernel carrier transport is present, identify the source carrier and the Lean carrier, show whether every stage is one joint draw or a source-defined conditional kernel composition, and classify the measure as a source pushforward, source conditioning/restriction, source-defined joint kernel law, generated product/kernel measure, or weighted/tilted measure. A rate-free or rate-indexed source claim needs a checked rate-indexed family bridge, not one selected Lean rate. When the elaborated surface contains a ReflTransGen path and a relation-valued state transition, identify the concrete source executor, initial/terminal states, and transition relation; a caller-supplied trace, serialization, or refinement package requires its own checked construction from source primitives.

dimensions.required_check: State exactly whether source and Lean use a pointwise conditional law, an almost-everywhere conditional version, positive-fiber identities, or measurable-event calibration. theorem source_proposition6_linear_combination_settings
    {n ell : ℕ} (S : Fin ell → JointLawCollaborationSetting n)
    (w : Fin ell → ℝ)
    (hw_nonneg : ∀ r : Fin ell, 0 ≤ w r)
    (hw_sum : ∑ r : Fin ell, w r = 1) :
    ∃ Smix : JointLawCollaborationSetting n,
      (∀ i : Fin n,
        Smix.agentAccuracy i = ∑ r : Fin ell, w r * (S r).agentAccuracy i) ∧
      (∀ C : CollaborationStrategy n,
        (∀ r : Fin ell,
          source_assumption_strategy_expectation_well_formed (S r) C) →
        source_assumption_strategy_expectation_well_formed Smix C ∧
          Smix.strategyAccuracy C =
            ∑ r : Fin ell, w r * (S r).strategyAccuracy C) := by
  refine ⟨JointLawCollaborationSetting.mix S w hw_nonneg hw_sum,
    JointLawCollaborationSetting.agentAccuracy_mix S w hw_nonneg hw_sum, ?_⟩
  intro C hC
  exact ⟨JointLawCollaborationSetting.strategyWellFormed_mix
      S w hw_nonneg hw_sum C hC,
    JointLawCollaborationSetting.strategyAccuracy_mix
      S w hw_nonneg hw_sum C hC⟩

    {n : ℕ} {C : CollaborationStrategy n} {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hp : Interior p)
    {k : Fin n} (hhalf_ne : p k ≠ (1 : ℝ) / 2)
    (hbad : C p ≠ roundProb (p k)) :

  · intro i
    have hweak := part1Setting_weakCounterexample (C := C) hp hhalf_ne hbad
    simpa [T, FiniteCollaborationSetting.toAccuracySurface,

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: The raw joint-law mixture scales every measurable embedded input-label event by its component weight, preserves predictors on that component, preserves each agent accuracy, and preserves strategy accuracy when the source expectation is well formed.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This is an event-level full-joint-law statement; it deliberately does not assert a nonexistent pointwise conditional-label equality on arbitrary null fibers.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Form the disjoint-union mixture of collaboration settings and obtain the two displayed componentwise accuracy equations.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: For each of the three source finite witnesses, Lean defines the exact cell map, constructs its predictor from the raw finite input-label PMF, and proves pointwise equality with the witness predictor used in the calibration and strict-gap arguments.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes construction provenance for every finite partition actually used by the proof. It does not extend the separate generic partition paragraph beyond finite measurable cell maps.
checked_proof_steps.source_locator: cited publication:198-247; cited publication:283-292; cited publication:314-340
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Use the displayed agent-dependent finite partitions in Lemma 8 and in both Proposition 9 settings to obtain the advertised predictors as conditional label-one probabilities of their cells.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: From the negation of fixed off-half deferral, the checked construction chooses one interior bad tuple per agent, forms the literal uniform finite mixture, and embeds it as a raw joint-law setting on which strategy accuracy is strictly below every agent accuracy.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes the strict uniform-mixture inequality itself, rather than relying only on a later reliability conclusion.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Average one Lemma 8 setting per agent with weight 1/n and infer that every agent strictly beats the strategy.

checked_proof_steps.checked_conclusion: The checked construction uses the concrete weights 7/8 for S1 and 1/8 for S2, proves both componentwise accuracy equations, and proves the resulting raw joint-law setting has strategy accuracy strictly below every agent accuracy.
checked_proof_steps.scope: This closes the source's existential close-enough argument with one explicit rational witness.
checked_proof_steps.source_step: Take lambda sufficiently close to one when mixing S1 and S2 so that every agent strictly beats the strategy.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean defines both pointwise quantities and proves expected correctness equals one minus expected 0-1 loss for each binary prediction and conditional label probability.
defects.repair_obligation: Distinguish pointwise expected correctness from 0-1 loss and prove that the two quantities sum to one.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked source-facing correction proves the complement identity by cases on the binary prediction; the model and all witness accuracies use expected correctness.
defects.source_claim: The source labels E[|Yhat(X)-Y|] as 0-1 accuracy, although this expectation is 0-1 loss; the later agent formula and proof use expected correctness.
defects.status_impact_rationale: This is a local terminology/complement typo. Replacing the opening quantity by one minus the displayed loss agrees with the subsequent individual-accuracy formula and leaves every advertised result unchanged.

defects.acceptance_condition: The report identifies event calibration as the accepted source reading, and Lean proves calibration and accuracy from that exact model.
defects.repair_obligation: Record the accepted event-calibration reading visibly rather than silently choosing a pointwise conditional version.
defects.resolution_evidence: The current raw model makes the event identity explicit and proves the agent-accuracy formula. The report records the user-approved interpretation rather than claiming a selected conditional version on every null fiber.
defects.source_claim: Calibration is written as a point-conditioned equality for every p in Image(P), without defining a conditional probability on a zero-probability prediction fiber.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The source wording is under-specified on null prediction fibers, but the user approved the event-calibration reading as the formal source model. Lean proves calibration and the advertised accuracy formula in that explicit model.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean checks equal point accuracies for the paper's correct and incorrect labels at eta=1/2, and separately derives a strict gap from correctness, incorrectness, and eta not equal to 1/2.
defects.repair_obligation: Exhibit the half-tie counterexample and prove strict accuracy dominance after adding eta not equal to one half.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked interface contains both the half-tie counterexample and the repaired strict-gap statement; the Lemma 8 witness proves its strict comparisons directly rather than using the defective unrestricted sentence.
defects.source_claim: The proof preliminaries claim that one positive-mass point where classifier i is correct and classifier j is incorrect always makes i strictly more accurate than j.
defects.status_impact_rationale: At conditional label probability one half, the tie convention names one label correct and the other incorrect although both have accuracy one half. Adding the omitted non-tie condition repairs the observation, and later witness cells that use strict correctness have conditional label probability zero or one.

defects.acceptance_condition: The checked mixture uses one nonnegative weight per component, proves that the weights sum to one, and derives both displayed accuracy equations with the same component index.
defects.repair_obligation: Use the component-indexed weight lambda_m consistently in the sampling sentence and normalization argument.
defects.resolution_evidence: The raw mixture is defined by the component weight at the sampled component, proves measurable embedded joint-event scaling by that weight, and derives the agent and strategy linearity equations.
defects.source_claim: After defining the component law with lambda_m in the displayed equation, the prose says to sample component m with probability lambda_ell.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The componentwise displayed equations unambiguously use lambda_m, so this is a one-symbol prose typo and does not change the mixture theorem or its use later in the proof.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean proves the finite raw-law partition construction and the exact Lemma 8 and Proposition 9 source cell maps under the accepted totalization.
defects.repair_obligation: Record the accepted finite measurable partition and zero-cell convention visibly.
defects.resolution_evidence: The current direct raw-law construction proves event calibration for finite measurable cell maps, assigns zero to a null cell, and proves that every source witness partition yields its displayed predictor. The report records this user-approved scope convention.
defects.source_claim: The source says that an arbitrary partition induces a calibrated predictor by assigning every cell its conditional label-one probability, without measurability, null-cell, or finiteness conditions.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The source does not spell out measurability or a null-cell value, but the user approved the finite measurable, zero-cell totalization used by every source witness as the formal source reading.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean proves the forward theorem under the explicit raw joint-law event-calibration convention and constructs a finite calibrated one-agent setting on which an interior-non-collaborative boundary-flipping strategy has agent accuracy one and strategy accuracy zero.
defects.repair_obligation: Keep the source's forward reliability-to-non-collaboration theorem and refute the converse using a non-collaborative strategy whose boundary behavior fails reliability on a calibrated setting.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked interface proves the forward implication and an explicit raw joint-law refutation of the converse by embedding the calibrated finite boundary setting.
defects.source_claim: The proof section restates Theorem 1 as an if-and-only-if between reliability and the interior fixed-agent/fixed-tie condition, although Definition 4 constrains no boundary profile.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The advertised Theorem 1 is only the forward implication and the source proof establishes that direction. Removing the accidental converse leaves the main theorem and proof route unchanged; the failure is confined to unconstrained boundary behavior already acknowledged by Definition 4.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean formalizes the entire S1 family for 0 < epsilon < 1/2, proves the displayed masses, predictors, calibration, and strict gap for every other agent.
defects.repair_obligation: State the positive lower bound needed for the conditional probabilities and for the claimed interior profiles.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked parameterized S1 construction uses exactly 0 < epsilon < 1/2; its epsilon=1/4 instance is retained only as a regression specialization.
defects.source_claim: The first Proposition 9 setting says only epsilon < 1/2 while using epsilon and 1-epsilon as conditional probabilities and asserting that both induced profiles lie in (0,1)^n.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The missing lower bound is an ordinary implicit probability/interiority condition. The repaired family 0 < epsilon < 1/2 preserves the source construction and all displayed formulas.

defects.acceptance_condition: Lean defines the S2 law using exactly that normalized denominator, proves its calibration and center profiles, and proves the source strict gap for agent k from opposite strategy outputs on the two half-slice profiles.
defects.repair_obligation: Use the single normalization D = 2 + sum_{j in [n]} (p_j/(1-p_j) + (1-q_j)/q_j), and prove that the two center masses and all paired masses form a probability distribution with the stated cell means.
defects.resolution_evidence: The checked S2 construction normalizes the p-copy and q-copy odds by the sum of their two finite denominators, which expands to the repaired displayed D, and proves the required calibration and strict agent-k comparison.
defects.source_claim: The displayed S2 mass denominator writes a sum over j of p_j/(1-p_j) followed by a free-index term (1-q_j)/q_j, so as printed it does not define one normalized distribution.
defects.status_impact_rationale: The intended paired-copy construction is clear from the two mass families and is repaired by putting both odds terms under the sum. This changes a free-index typo, not the construction's advertised strict-gap role.

model_conventions.checked_scope: The current source-facing model proves the individual-accuracy formula from this event identity and embeds each finite adversarial witness as an exact joint PMF with unchanged classifier accuracies.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: A collaboration setting is represented by one probability law on X x {0,1}, rather than by an input marginal plus a selected pointwise conditional-label function. Predictors are measurable [0,1]-valued functions and calibration means, for every measurable A, E[1_{P_i(X) in A,Y=1}] = E[P_i(X) 1_{P_i(X) in A}].
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: User-approved formalization convention: the paper's calibration display is read through this event-calibration semantics. The report records that this does not select a pointwise conditional version on every arbitrary input space.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source writes conditioning on P_i(X)=p for every reported p, but a raw joint law does not canonically specify conditional probabilities on zero-probability prediction fibers. The event identity is meaningful for both atomic and atomless prediction laws.

model_conventions.checked_scope: The raw reliability predicate carries the strategy-expectation well-formedness premise; the source proof's finite witnesses discharge it directly.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: Predictors are measurable, and a strategy is used in an accuracy comparison only when its induced binary-correctness indicator is integrable under the joint law. On finite witnesses this condition is automatic.
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: This is an analytic well-formedness convention, not a claim that every set-theoretic deterministic function [0,1]^n -> {0,1} is measurable on every possible input space.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source uses P_i(X), calibration events, and expected strategy accuracy while allowing an arbitrary deterministic C. Those expressions need measurability and integrability on an arbitrary measurable input space.

model_conventions.checked_scope: Every partition used by the source's Lemma 8 and Proposition 9 witnesses is finite and is covered by the raw joint-law construction, including agent-dependent finite cell types.
model_conventions.formal_meaning: The checked partition construction takes a finite measurable cell map for each agent. A positive-mass cell receives true-label mass divided by total cell mass; a null cell is assigned zero.
model_conventions.unresolved_relation_to_literal_source: User-approved formalization convention: the source partition sentence is read as the finite measurable cell construction used by its proof, with zero on a null cell. The report retains this scope choice without treating arbitrary atomless partitions as an open proof obligation.
model_conventions.why_needed: The source says only 'partition'. Measurability is needed to form the events, and finiteness is needed for the checked zero-cell totalization to remain expectation-irrelevant and for the calibrated event identity to follow by a finite sum.
